name: Build static blog indexes

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  # Canonical public URL. Keep this without a trailing slash.
  SITE_URL: https://blog.kusteo.com

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Generate posts.json
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import { promises as fs } from 'node:fs';
          import path from 'node:path';

          const POSTS_DIR = path.resolve('content/posts');
          const OUT_DIR = path.resolve('data');
          await fs.mkdir(OUT_DIR, { recursive: true });

          function parseScalar(raw) {
            const value = raw.trim();
            if (value === 'true') return true;
            if (value === 'false') return false;
            if ((value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')) || (value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'"))) {
              return value.slice(1, -1).replace(/\\([\\"'])/g, '$1');
            }
            if (value.startsWith('[') && value.endsWith(']')) {
              return value.slice(1, -1).split(',').map(item => item.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(parseScalar);
            }
            return value;
          }

          function parseFrontmatter(source) {
            const normalized = source.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n');
            if (!normalized.startsWith('---\n')) throw new Error('Missing YAML frontmatter');
            const end = normalized.indexOf('\n---', 4);
            if (end === -1) throw new Error('Unclosed YAML frontmatter');
            const data = {};
            for (const line of normalized.slice(4, end).split('\n')) {
              const trimmed = line.trim();
              if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue;
              const match = trimmed.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+):\s*(.*)$/);
              if (!match) throw new Error(`Unsupported frontmatter line: ${line}`);
              data[match[1]] = parseScalar(match[2]);
            }
            return data;
          }

          const entries = await fs.readdir(POSTS_DIR, { withFileTypes: true });
          const posts = [];
          for (const entry of entries) {
            if (!entry.isFile() || !entry.name.endsWith('.md')) continue;
            const slug = entry.name.slice(0, -3);
            if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(slug)) {
              throw new Error(`Invalid slug: ${slug}. Use lowercase English letters, numbers, and hyphens only.`);
            }
            const source = await fs.readFile(path.join(POSTS_DIR, entry.name), 'utf8');
            const frontmatter = parseFrontmatter(source);
            if (frontmatter.draft === true) continue;
            if (!frontmatter.title || !frontmatter.date) throw new Error(`${entry.name}: title and date are required.`);
            const date = new Date(frontmatter.date);
            if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) throw new Error(`${entry.name}: invalid ISO date: ${frontmatter.date}`);
            const tags = Array.isArray(frontmatter.tags) ? frontmatter.tags.map(String) : [];
            posts.push({ slug, title: String(frontmatter.title), date: String(frontmatter.date), tags, summary: String(frontmatter.summary || '') });
          }

          posts.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date) - new Date(a.date));
          await fs.writeFile(path.join(OUT_DIR, 'posts.json'), JSON.stringify(posts, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf8');
          console.log(`Generated posts.json with ${posts.length} published posts.`);
          NODE

      # Generate a full-text RSS feed. This is the only functional change needed
      # for RSS readers that show "Loading article..." when opening the article page.
      - name: Generate feed.xml
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import { promises as fs } from 'node:fs';
          import path from 'node:path';

          const SITE_URL = process.env.SITE_URL.replace(/\/$/, '');
          const config = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.resolve('config.json'), 'utf8'));
          const SITE_NAME = String(config.siteName || 'TeoGeek');
          const SITE_DESCRIPTION = String(config.siteDescription || '');
          const posts = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.resolve('data/posts.json'), 'utf8'));
          const POSTS_DIR = path.resolve('content/posts');

          const escapeXml = value => String(value ?? '')
            .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
            .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
            .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
            .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
            .replaceAll("'", '&apos;');

          const escapeHtml = value => String(value ?? '')
            .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
            .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
            .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
            .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
            .replaceAll("'", '&#39;');

          function inlineMarkdown(value) {
            let text = escapeHtml(value);
            text = text.replace(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^\s)]+)(?:\s+"([^"]*)")?\)/g, (_, alt, url, title) =>
              `<img src="${escapeHtml(url)}" alt="${alt}"${title ? ` title="${escapeHtml(title)}"` : ''} loading="lazy">`);
            text = text.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^\s)]+)(?:\s+"([^"]*)")?\)/g, (_, label, url, title) =>
              `<a href="${escapeHtml(url)}"${title ? ` title="${escapeHtml(title)}"` : ''}>${label}</a>`);
            text = text.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
            text = text.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
            text = text.replace(/__([^_]+)__/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
            text = text.replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>');
            text = text.replace(/_([^_]+)_/g, '<em>$1</em>');
            return text;
          }

          function markdownToHtml(markdown) {
            const normalized = markdown.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n');
            const body = normalized.replace(/^---\n[\s\S]*?\n---\n?/, '');
            const lines = body.split('\n');
            const out = [];
            let paragraph = [];
            let listType = null;
            let listItems = [];
            let quote = [];
            let code = null;

            const flushParagraph = () => {
              if (!paragraph.length) return;
              out.push(`<p>${inlineMarkdown(paragraph.join(' '))}</p>`);
              paragraph = [];
            };
            const flushList = () => {
              if (!listType) return;
              const tag = listType === 'ol' ? 'ol' : 'ul';
              out.push(`<${tag}>${listItems.map(item => `<li>${inlineMarkdown(item)}</li>`).join('')}</${tag}>`);
              listType = null;
              listItems = [];
            };
            const flushQuote = () => {
              if (!quote.length) return;
              out.push(`<blockquote><p>${inlineMarkdown(quote.join(' '))}</p></blockquote>`);
              quote = [];
            };

            for (const line of lines) {
              if (code) {
                if (/^```/.test(line)) {
                  out.push(`<pre><code${code.lang ? ` class="language-${escapeHtml(code.lang)}"` : ''}>${escapeHtml(code.lines.join('\n'))}</code></pre>`);
                  code = null;
                } else {
                  code.lines.push(line);
                }
                continue;
              }

              const fence = line.match(/^```\s*([\w+-]*)\s*$/);
              if (fence) {
                flushParagraph();
                flushList();
                flushQuote();
                code = { lang: fence[1] || '', lines: [] };
                continue;
              }

              if (!line.trim()) {
                flushParagraph();
                flushList();
                flushQuote();
                continue;
              }

              const heading = line.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.+?)\s*#*$/);
              if (heading) {
                flushParagraph();
                flushList();
                flushQuote();
                const level = heading[1].length;
                out.push(`<h${level}>${inlineMarkdown(heading[2])}</h${level}>`);
                continue;
              }

              const bullet = line.match(/^\s*[-*+]\s+(.+)$/);
              const ordered = line.match(/^\s*\d+[.)]\s+(.+)$/);
              if (bullet || ordered) {
                flushParagraph();
                flushQuote();
                const type = ordered ? 'ol' : 'ul';
                if (listType && listType !== type) flushList();
                listType = type;
                listItems.push((bullet || ordered)[1]);
                continue;
              }

              const blockquote = line.match(/^\s*>\s?(.*)$/);
              if (blockquote) {
                flushParagraph();
                flushList();
                quote.push(blockquote[1]);
                continue;
              }

              flushList();
              flushQuote();
              paragraph.push(line.trim());
            }

            if (code) {
              out.push(`<pre><code>${escapeHtml(code.lines.join('\n'))}</code></pre>`);
            }
            flushParagraph();
            flushList();
            flushQuote();
            return out.join('\n');
          }

          const items = [];
          for (const post of posts) {
            const source = await fs.readFile(path.join(POSTS_DIR, `${post.slug}.md`), 'utf8');
            const contentHtml = markdownToHtml(source);
            const link = `${SITE_URL}/post.html?slug=${encodeURIComponent(post.slug)}`;
            items.push([
              '    <item>',
              `      <title>${escapeXml(post.title)}</title>`,
              `      <link>${escapeXml(link)}</link>`,
              `      <description>${escapeXml(post.summary || '')}</description>`,
              `      <content:encoded><![CDATA[${contentHtml.replaceAll(']]>', ']]]]><![CDATA[>')}]]></content:encoded>`,
              `      <pubDate>${escapeXml(new Date(post.date).toUTCString())}</pubDate>`,
              `      <guid isPermaLink="true">${escapeXml(link)}</guid>`,
              '    </item>',
            ].join('\n'));
          }

          const lastBuildDate = posts.length ? new Date(posts[0].date).toUTCString() : new Date().toUTCString();
          const xml = [
            '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>',
            '<rss version="2.0" xmlns:content="http://purl.org/rss/1.0/modules/content/">',
            '  <channel>',
            `    <title>${escapeXml(SITE_NAME)}</title>`,
            `    <link>${escapeXml(SITE_URL + '/')}</link>`,
            `    <description>${escapeXml(SITE_DESCRIPTION)}</description>`,
            '    <language>en</language>',
            `    <lastBuildDate>${escapeXml(lastBuildDate)}</lastBuildDate>`,
            items.join('\n'),
            '  </channel>',
            '</rss>',
            '',
          ].join('\n');

          await fs.writeFile(path.resolve('data/feed.xml'), xml, 'utf8');
          console.log(`Generated feed.xml with ${posts.length} published items and full content.`);
          NODE

      - name: Generate sitemap.xml
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import { promises as fs } from 'node:fs';
          import path from 'node:path';

          const SITE_URL = process.env.SITE_URL.replace(/\/$/, '');
          const posts = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(path.resolve('data/posts.json'), 'utf8'));
          const escapeXml = value => String(value ?? '')
            .replaceAll('&', '&amp;').replaceAll('<', '&lt;').replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
            .replaceAll('"', '&quot;').replaceAll("'", '&apos;');
          const defaultLastmod = posts[0]?.date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
          const urls = [
            `  <url><loc>${escapeXml(SITE_URL + '/index.html')}</loc><lastmod>${escapeXml(defaultLastmod)}</lastmod></url>`,
            `  <url><loc>${escapeXml(SITE_URL + '/about.html')}</loc><lastmod>${escapeXml(defaultLastmod)}</lastmod></url>`,
            ...posts.map(post => `  <url><loc>${escapeXml(`${SITE_URL}/post.html?slug=${encodeURIComponent(post.slug)}`)}</loc><lastmod>${escapeXml(post.date)}</lastmod></url>`),
          ];
          const xml = [
            '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>',
            '<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">',
            ...urls,
            '</urlset>',
            '',
          ].join('\n');
          await fs.writeFile(path.resolve('data/sitemap.xml'), xml, 'utf8');
          console.log(`Generated sitemap.xml with ${urls.length} URLs.`);
          NODE

      - name: Commit generated data
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data/posts.json data/feed.xml data/sitemap.xml
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No generated data changes to commit."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "chore: update generated blog indexes"
          git push origin HEAD:main
